claims: Gerry McNamara is the head coach of the Siena College men's basketball team.
Gerry McNamara was hired on March 29, 2024.
Gerry McNamara is a former Syracuse standout.
Gerry McNamara spent 15 years on staff at Syracuse before Siena.
Syracuse is Gerry McNamara's alma mater.
Gerry McNamara spent time as an assistant coach at Syracuse.
Gerry McNamara guided Siena to a 23-11 record in the 2025-26 season.
Siena won the MAAC tournament championship in the 2025-26 season.
Gerry McNamara led Siena to a 10-win improvement in his first season (2024-25).
Siena went from 4-28 to 14-18 in the 2024-25 season.
Gerry McNamara was a finalist for the Joe B. Hall Award.
Siena is a 16th seed in the 2026 NCAA tournament.
Siena is facing Duke in the 2026 NCAA tournament.
Sports Illustrated reported media reports linking Gerry McNamara to the open head coaching job at Syracuse.
